model: PCU constant pressure controller (PCM plenum pressurization)
applies_to: Price PCU controllers running the constant pressure sequence for underfloor plenum pressurization (PCM).
summary: The PCU in its constant pressure sequence modulates a damper to hold underfloor plenum pressure. The points list has 27 objects: pressure sensors and target, occupied/unoccupied pressure setpoints, damper position and override, room temperature/CO2/humidity from the thermostat, and BMS override values for setpoint, room temperature, occupancy and lights.
notes: Instances named N/A in the list (unused: AV 4, AV 5, AV 6, AV 7, AV 8, AV 14, AV 15, AV 16, AV 20, AV 21, AV 22, AV 23, AV 24, AV 26) are left out.
Several AV objects carry coded values; the codes are listed in the states field.
The list also marks which values are retained after a power failure.

source.title: BACnet points list for PCU firmware v1.04 Constant Pressure

points.name: T1 Temperature Sensor
points.description: Current temperature reading from T1 Sensor

points.name: T2 Temperature Snsor
points.description: Current temperature reading from T2 Sensor

points.name: Humidity Reading
points.description: Current Relitive Humidity at the T-Stat

points.name: Occupancy Source
points.states: 0=Occupied from VVT (Default Mode), 2=Occupied from Contact Closure, 3=Occupied from T-Stat Button, 4=Occupied from Motion Sensor, 5=Occupied from Network Override, 12=Unoccupied from Contact Closure, 14=Unoccupied from Motion Sensor, 15=Unoccupied from Network Override

points.name: Analog Heat Output Voltage
points.description: Current voltage on the Analog Heat output (AO2)

points.name: Analog Cool Output Voltage
points.description: Current voltage on the Analog Cool output (AO3)

points.name: PING
points.description: Number of times the LCD T-Stat will beep

points.name: Binary Output Status Code
points.description: Binary outputs as a bit field: bit 0 = BO1 ... bit 4 = BO5

points.name: Current Damper Position
points.description: Current damper position in percent, 999% indicates the damper is recalibrating itself

points.name: Remote Mode Flag
points.states: 0=Automatic control (normal run mode), 1=Target Cool Min, 2=Target Cool Max, 3=Target Heat Min, 4=Target Heat Max, 5=Target Neutral Damper Position, 6=Open Damper 100%, 7=Close Damper (0%)

points.name: Net Setpoint
points.description: Setpoint override from the network (0 = normal operation)

points.name: Net Room Temp
points.description: Room temperature override from the network (0 = normal operation)

points.name: Net Lights
points.description: Room Lights override from BACnet network

integration.summary: Write AV 19 Pressure Setpoint and AV 30 Net Occupancy; read AI 2 Current Pressure, AV 1 Pressure Target and AV 18 damper position.
integration.enable: AV 30 Net Occupancy: 0 = normal operation, 1 = force occupied, 2 = force unoccupied. AV 25 Remote Mode Flag can override the damper (0 = automatic).
setup: BACnet MS/TP; Price default baud rate is 76800.
